messages:
Mia: Quick heads-up — our eval harness started piling up retries on shard-7 during the nightly quant CI run, causing queue depth to spike and timeouts. Logs below.
Devin: ack. Saw higher latencies in Grafana for eval-runner-2 around 02:13 UTC. Any stack traces?
Mia: pasted logs:
```
ERROR EvalRunner shard=7 dispatch: RetryLoopExceeded job=evaller/1234 attempts=5 last_err='lease timeout' worker=worker-12
queue_len=128 backlog_ms=4200
```
Sasha: hmm worker-12 heartbeat shows flapping. Could be the new batch-size=16 quant variant causing OOM + restart on 16GB nodes.
Eli: adding context: we bumped default inter-shard lease from 10s -> 6s in PR #482. That may amplify retry storms when workers are slow to pick up leases.
Devin: can we correlate with CI mesh? CI runner shows concurrent evals spiking from 48 -> 120 right after the model onboard.
Mia: yes. new model "redwood-small-quant" has very short sequence distribution and high concurrency which reduces kernel reuse, increasing task overhead per request.
Ron: suggest temporary mitigations: increase inter-shard lease to 12s and enable per-shard rate limiting (token bucket refill=10/s burst=20). Also add metrics: shard_retries_total and shard_backpressure_gauge.
Sasha: +1 for metrics. We also need a dashboard card for a "retry waterfall" and an alert: if shard_retries_total > 50 within 5m then page eng-ml.
Eli: added GH issue for metrics + dashboard: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/923
Mia: I'll roll a staging canary with lease=12s and reduce concurrent evals to 40. Will post results in 15m.
Devin: FYI CI flake: test `eval-harness::integration::shard-saturation` started failing with assertion that dispatch latency < 2s. We should either loosen to < 5s or simulate backpressure in CI.
Mia: let's not loosen the assertion. Better approach: add a synthetic backpressure fixture to make the test deterministic under realistic worker pauses.
Ron: Ops note: node pool autoscaler didn't kick because CPU looked fine but GPU memory was thrashing. Need autoscaler to consider GPU mem stall metric. Filed OPS ticket: OPS-314.
Mia: staging canary results after 20m: queue depth dropped from 128 -> 22, retries down from 67 -> 3. Good signal. Can we push to prod at 03:30 after infra approval? :thumbsup:
Devin: approve, but keep canary traffic at 10% for 1h. Also enable log sampling for worker restarts and add a short-lived debug flag to capture stack traces on future retry loops.
ops-bot: Deploy started: canary config lease=12s concurrency=40 token_bucket=10/s burst=20 — status: in_progress
Mia: thanks — monitoring looks stable. I'll follow up with a short postmortem and concrete CI changes (backpressure fixture + test adjustment).
